entries.title: Concerto No. 5 ("Emperor")
entries.finding: The National Library of New Zealand catalogue records Rubinstein/Krips/Symphony of the Air’s complete RCA Beethoven concerto cycle at Manhattan Center6–16December1956. The saved RCA63036collection contains the complete three-movement Emperor with those positive musicians and Beethoven alone as Composer. The contemporaneous February1957HighFidelity eyewitness account corroborates the stereo RCA sessions. This supports the recording family rather than an exact1958LSC2124pressing or digital master.
entries.next_action: Retain recording-family/edition limitations; no further action needed for this frozen programme.
